description: Get flights for an ident — a flight designator (e.g. UAL123, AAL100), aircraft registration (e.g. N12345), or fa_flight_id. Returns recent, current, and scheduled flights for that ident.

cursor.description: Paging cursor: the cursor query parameter of a previous response's links.next (passing the whole links.next value also works)

end.description: ISO-8601 end of the time window

max_pages.description: Max pages to fetch, 1-20 (AeroAPI default: 1). Capped at 20 since AeroAPI bills per page.

start.description: ISO-8601 start of the time window

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands. compact strips image/avatar URLs from the response; "full" returns FlightAware's payload untouched. No field projection: this server has no verified record of which FlightAware fields matter, and inventing one would risk dropping a field a caller needs.

name: fa_get_flights
